environment.description: CLI tool deployed on bare-metal Ubuntu 22.04 server. Compiled with gcc -O2 (no ASAN, no stack canaries forced). The DATABASE_URL connects as 'app_admin' role which has full DML/DDL privileges (GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES). The tool reads untrusted input from a named pipe fed by an external service. ASLR is disabled via sysctl kernel.randomize_va_space=0 for debugging purposes. No seccomp or AppArmor profile applied.

config.input_source: named pipe from untrusted external service
